name: Model Compression Pipeline for 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: 3DGS Model Compression Pipeline — Edge-deployment compression, LightGaussian-derived compression
definition: A compression pipeline combining Gaussian pruning, fine-tuning, SH distillation, Vector Quantization (VQ) for SH coefficients and colors, and FP16 quantization, designed to reduce computational complexity and memory usage for hardware-oriented 3DGS deployment.
